resale_co.how_to_apply: No Township resale Certificate of Occupancy. The Township's FAQ says a C.O. is not required for the sale of a home; you need the smoke detector certification from the Livingston Fire Department (see fire certificate). The Building Department recommends calling well ahead of closing to check for open permits.

evidence.quote: No, a C.O. is not required.
Is a C.O. (Certificate of Occupancy) required for the sale of my home?

resale_co.notes: The Township FAQ (Building Department) says a C.O. is not required for the sale of a home, recommends calling the Building Department at 973-992-5000 ext. #5200 well before closing to check for open permits, and says a smoke detector certification from the Fire Department is needed. Martin J. Chiarolanzio's direct line is ext. #5201 (Building page; email is a mailto link, mchiarolanzio@livingstonnj.org). The Zoning page lists a $75 Zoning Confirmation Letter, which is optional and not described as a sale requirement. The Fire Prevention Bureau also inspects rental re-occupancy; that is a rental item, not a resale CO.

requirements: Smoke detector on each level: basement at the bottom of the stairs, and each floor at the stairs or within 10 feet of bedrooms; attic not required
Battery smoke detectors must be 10-year sealed units; homes built with hardwired interconnected detectors cannot substitute battery or wireless units
Carbon monoxide detector(s) within 10 feet of all bedroom areas; battery, hardwired or plug-in allowed
All detectors UL listed and mounted with screws (no tape, Velcro, nails or picture hooks), except plug-in CO units

One ABC fire extinguisher, 2A:10B:C or greater, wall mounted about 5 feet off the floor in a visible spot in or within 10 feet of the kitchen, not in a cabinet or behind a door; one per kitchen (form still lists it)

authorities.name: Livingston Fire Department, Fire Prevention Bureau
authorities.lead_time: Call to schedule at least 10 days before closing. Fees are paid at the inspection.

fees.label: Smoke detector and CO alarm certificate, 1 and 2 family, initial inspection
fees.quote: There is a required $75 fee for each initial inspection.

fees.label: Re-inspection after an unsuccessful initial inspection
fees.quote: For each re-inspection required following an unsuccessful initial inspection, there is an additional charge of $35.

fees.label: Waiver in lieu of smoke detector inspection (demolition properties only)
fees.quote: Waiver in Lieu of Smoke Detector Inspection (demolition properties only): $25

authorities.how_to_apply: Call the Livingston Fire Prevention Bureau at 973-992-2373, Monday through Friday (8:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.), to schedule the inspection at least 10 days before closing. Pay at the time of inspection by cash or check payable to the Township of Livingston (no credit cards). A Smoke Detector Waiver Request Form is posted for demolition properties.

evidence.quote: This is required, and you will not be able to sell your home or allow a renter to occupy the premises until the property has passed the inspection.
We kindly ask that you call to schedule an inspection at least 10 days prior to your closing.
All fees are to be paid during the inspection by cash or check.
One ABC rated fire extinguisher with a classification code of 2A:10B:C or greater shall be wall mounted
LEAID: 0710-001 Livingston Twp ... Fire Official Christopher Mullin Phone (973) 992-2373 ... Email cmullin@livingstonnj.org

fire_cert.notes: Fees ($75 initial, $35 per re-inspection) match on the Township page, the August 2026 requirements sheet and the fire fee ordinance (Ordinance No. 25-2026, Chapter 141). The requirements sheet, updated August 2026, still requires a 2A:10B:C fire extinguisher even though the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19); confirm with the Bureau. The Fire Chief's direct email in the state directory is cmullin@livingstonnj.org; the Department's general email is lfd@livingstonnj.org.

other_items.label: Open permits check
other_items.detail: The Building Department recommends calling 973-992-5000 ext. #5200 well before closing to find any open permits, which could slow the sale.
